description: Registry of known project blueprints. Consumed by shared/skills/bootstrap-project/ and available for other skills to reference. Each entry points at a full blueprint file under shared/blueprints/.

patterns.name: Saturday — E2E Test Framework
patterns.oneLiner: Site-Centric E2E automation with Cucumber.js + Playwright + OTel, plus a Vue dashboard.

languages.note: TypeScript is the reference implementation. Python/C#/Java/Go ports exist but have varying maturity — see saturday.md for status per port.

patterns.name: Sunday — API Test Framework
patterns.oneLiner: Clean Architecture API testing with Vitest + Playwright + Zod + BaseApiClient + Resilience Primitives.

languages.note: TypeScript-only. Port to other languages would follow the same Clean Architecture layout but is not yet blueprinted.

patterns.name: MCP Server
patterns.oneLiner: Model Context Protocol server exposing tools, personas, and workflows to Claude and other MCP clients.

languages.note: Go is the suggested default (matches CLAUDE.md's Backend/MCP declaration, single-binary distribution). TypeScript is fully first-class — the MCP SDK is mature in both languages. The design pattern (tool / persona / workflow trinity + Clean Architecture layers) is what matters; the language is a soft preference the interviewee should pick.

patterns.name: Scribe — Content Publishing CLI
patterns.oneLiner: Go CLI for publishing content across multiple channels (RSS, S3, Bluesky, LinkedIn, etc.). Single binary via GoReleaser.

languages.note: Go-only. The single-binary distribution model is core to the pattern.

patterns.name: Clean Architecture Backend Service
patterns.oneLiner: Polyglot backend service (HTTP/gRPC/queue-consumer) with strict Clean Architecture layers.

languages.note: Go is the default backend language in this ecosystem. Other languages follow the same layer structure with language-specific idioms.

patterns.name: Clean Architecture CLI
patterns.oneLiner: Command-line tool with Clean Architecture layers. Domain logic testable without the CLI framework.

languages.note: Go via Cobra is the reference. TypeScript via Commander is supported for teams already in a Node monorepo.

patterns.name: Clean Architecture Library
patterns.oneLiner: Publishable library — pure domain and use-case layers, no adapters, no framework coupling.

languages.note: Language choice depends on the target ecosystem the library is being published into.

patterns.name: Frontend Application
patterns.oneLiner: Web frontend with strong recommendation for Vue 3 + Tailwind + Composition API, but user picks the framework.

languages.note: TypeScript is mandatory. Framework options (Vue 3, React, Svelte, Angular, SolidJS) are chosen during the interview. Vue 3 is the recommended default because it matches the rest of this ecosystem's frontend work.

patterns.name: Other / Custom
patterns.oneLiner: Falls back to generic Clean Architecture layout. Bootstrap-project will interview more deeply to determine required layers.

languages.note: No pre-set language. The bootstrap interview will ask.

unblueprintedIdeas.description: Ideas that have come up but do not yet have a blueprint. If a user picks one of these in the interview, bootstrap-project flags it and offers to either fall back to the closest match or defer and blueprint the pattern first as a separate task.
